quests.spatialHierarchy: Enclosed Space / Volume (e.g. in the room)
quests.question: The exhibit, tucked away ___ a quiet corner of the museum's east wing, rarely draws the crowds it deserves.
quests.targetSentence: The exhibit, tucked away in a quiet corner of the museum's east wing, rarely draws the crowds it deserves.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'In a corner' fits an interior pocket of space within a room or building; 'at a corner' is more typical of exterior street corners.
quests.nativeTip: This corner is an interior pocket of space, not an exterior street-level point.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'in' (Enclosed Space / Volume (e.g. in the room)) ➔ 'The exhibit, tucked away in a quiet corner of the museum's east wing, rarely draws the crowds it deserves.'

quests.question: By the time visitors reach the final gallery, they've walked nearly a mile ___ the museum's winding corridors.
quests.targetSentence: By the time visitors reach the final gallery, they've walked nearly a mile through the museum's winding corridors.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Through' fits movement inside a surrounding space like corridors, following the established pattern for enclosed movement.
quests.nativeTip: Corridors surround visitors on every side as they move, the same pattern taught with tunnels and forests.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'through' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'By the time visitors reach the final gallery, they've walked nearly a mile through the museum's winding corridors.'

quests.question: The curator has been meticulously cataloging the collection ___ nearly a decade, piece by piece.
quests.targetSentence: The curator has been meticulously cataloging the collection for nearly a decade, piece by piece.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'For' pairs with a stated duration, here nearly a decade, showing how long the cataloging has continued.
quests.nativeTip: A length of time is named, not a starting point.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'for' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'The curator has been meticulously cataloging the collection for nearly a decade, piece by piece.'

quests.question: The merger negotiations, which had dragged on inconclusively ___ over a year, were finally resolved last week.
quests.targetSentence: The merger negotiations, which had dragged on inconclusively for over a year, were finally resolved last week.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'For' fits the stated duration — over a year — describing how long the negotiations continued.
quests.nativeTip: A stretch of time is named here, not a fixed starting event.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'for' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'The merger negotiations, which had dragged on inconclusively for over a year, were finally resolved last week.'

quests.question: The clause stipulates that payment is due ___ thirty days of receiving the invoice, not thirty days after signing.
quests.targetSentence: The clause stipulates that payment is due within thirty days of receiving the invoice, not thirty days after signing.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Within' marks a time limit an action must occur inside, here thirty days from receiving the invoice.
quests.nativeTip: This sets an outer limit that the action must fall inside of.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'within' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'The clause stipulates that payment is due within thirty days of receiving the invoice, not thirty days after signing.'

quests.question: The company had already restructured twice ___ the time the audit began, making the findings largely irrelevant.
quests.targetSentence: The company had already restructured twice by the time the audit began, making the findings largely irrelevant.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'By the time' is a fixed idiomatic phrase meaning 'before or at the point when'; the other options don't fit this exact idiom.
quests.nativeTip: This is a fixed idiom marking a point already reached when something else happened.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'by' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'The company had already restructured twice by the time the audit began, making the findings largely irrelevant.'

quests.conceptTitle: Preposition Radar: Contrast: despite vs in spite of
quests.question: The board approved the proposal unanimously, ___ the overwhelming evidence against it, to everyone's surprise.
quests.targetSentence: The board approved the proposal unanimously, despite the overwhelming evidence against it, to everyone's surprise.
quests.grammarRule: Contrast: despite vs in spite of
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Despite' stands alone without 'of', the same rule taught earlier, regardless of how long or complex the surrounding sentence is.
quests.nativeTip: This word never takes 'of' after it, even in a longer, more sophisticated sentence.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'despite' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'The board approved the proposal unanimously, despite the overwhelming evidence against it, to everyone's surprise.'

quests.question: The revised policy takes effect immediately, ___ any prior agreements made under the old terms.
quests.targetSentence: The revised policy takes effect immediately, regardless of any prior agreements made under the old terms.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Regardless of' means 'without being affected by', showing the new policy overrides prior agreements entirely.
quests.nativeTip: This phrase means the new policy applies no matter what earlier agreements existed.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'regardless of' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'The revised policy takes effect immediately, regardless of any prior agreements made under the old terms.'

quests.question: The award recognizes her contributions ___ the field of renewable energy over the past twenty years.
quests.targetSentence: The award recognizes her contributions to the field of renewable energy over the past twenty years.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Contributions to' is the fixed idiom for describing work that advances a particular field.
quests.nativeTip: This links a person's work to the area it advanced.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'to' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'The award recognizes her contributions to the field of renewable energy over the past twenty years.'

quests.question: His reluctance ___ discuss the failed project stemmed from a deep sense of personal responsibility.
quests.targetSentence: His reluctance to discuss the failed project stemmed from a deep sense of personal responsibility.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Reluctance to' is the fixed pattern linking hesitation to the action being avoided.
quests.nativeTip: This noun is followed by the same word that introduces an infinitive verb.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'to' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'His reluctance to discuss the failed project stemmed from a deep sense of personal responsibility.'

quests.spatialHierarchy: Enclosed Space / Volume (e.g. in the room)
quests.question: The board's confidence ___ the CEO's leadership wavered following the disappointing quarterly results.
quests.targetSentence: The board's confidence in the CEO's leadership wavered following the disappointing quarterly results.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Confidence in' is the fixed idiom for expressing trust in someone's ability or judgment.
quests.nativeTip: This links trust to the person or ability it's placed in.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'in' (Enclosed Space / Volume (e.g. in the room)) ➔ 'The board's confidence in the CEO's leadership wavered following the disappointing quarterly results.'

quests.question: Her insistence ___ transparency throughout the process ultimately earned her the trust of skeptical stakeholders.
quests.targetSentence: Her insistence on transparency throughout the process ultimately earned her the trust of skeptical stakeholders.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Insistence on' is the fixed idiom for describing firm determination toward a specific requirement.
quests.nativeTip: This links firm determination to the specific thing being demanded.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'on' (Surface Contact (e.g. on the table)) ➔ 'Her insistence on transparency throughout the process ultimately earned her the trust of skeptical stakeholders.'

quests.spatialHierarchy: Enclosed Space / Volume (e.g. in the room)
quests.question: The two approaches differ significantly ___ their underlying assumptions, even though they arrive at similar conclusions.
quests.targetSentence: The two approaches differ significantly in their underlying assumptions, even though they arrive at similar conclusions.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Differ in' names the specific respect in which two things diverge, distinct from 'differ from', which introduces the thing being compared against.
quests.nativeTip: This names the specific aspect where the two things diverge.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'in' (Enclosed Space / Volume (e.g. in the room)) ➔ 'The two approaches differ significantly in their underlying assumptions, even though they arrive at similar conclusions.'

quests.conceptTitle: Preposition Radar: Contrast: between vs among
quests.question: Responsibility for the error was divided ___ the three team members who had worked on the report.
quests.targetSentence: Responsibility for the error was divided among the three team members who had worked on the report.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Among' fits because responsibility is shared by three people, the same rule taught earlier for groups larger than two.
quests.nativeTip: Three people share this, following the group-size rule taught earlier.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'among' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'Responsibility for the error was divided among the three team members who had worked on the report.'

quests.question: The final decision rests ___ the committee chair, not the individual members.
quests.targetSentence: The final decision rests with the committee chair, not the individual members.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Rests with' is the fixed idiom for showing where final authority or responsibility belongs.
quests.nativeTip: This is a fixed idiom for saying where authority or responsibility ultimately belongs.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'with' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'The final decision rests with the committee chair, not the individual members.'

quests.question: We regret to inform you that your application has not been successful ___ this occasion.
quests.targetSentence: We regret to inform you that your application has not been successful on this occasion.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'On this occasion' is the standard formal idiom used in professional rejection letters.
quests.nativeTip: This is the standard formal phrase for referring to a single instance or attempt.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'on' (Surface Contact (e.g. on the table)) ➔ 'We regret to inform you that your application has not been successful on this occasion.'

quests.question: The board has resolved to proceed ___ the acquisition, subject to shareholder approval.
quests.targetSentence: The board has resolved to proceed with the acquisition, subject to shareholder approval.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Proceed with' is the fixed idiom for continuing forward with a plan or action.
quests.nativeTip: This links continuing an action to the plan itself.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'with' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'The board has resolved to proceed with the acquisition, subject to shareholder approval.'

quests.question: All correspondence should be addressed ___ the office of the general counsel.
quests.targetSentence: All correspondence should be addressed to the office of the general counsel.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Addressed to' is the fixed idiom for naming the intended recipient of correspondence.
quests.nativeTip: This links a letter to its intended recipient.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'to' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'All correspondence should be addressed to the office of the general counsel.'

quests.spatialHierarchy: Enclosed Space / Volume (e.g. in the room)
quests.question: I'm not really ___ the mood for a big night out, if I'm honest.
quests.targetSentence: I'm not really in the mood for a big night out, if I'm honest.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'In the mood for' is a fixed idiom describing a temporary desire or willingness to do something.
quests.nativeTip: This is a fixed idiom describing a temporary emotional state.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'in' (Enclosed Space / Volume (e.g. in the room)) ➔ 'I'm not really in the mood for a big night out, if I'm honest.'

quests.question: She's finally coming ___ terms with her diagnosis after months of denial.
quests.targetSentence: She's finally coming to terms with her diagnosis after months of denial.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Come to terms with' is a fixed idiom meaning to gradually accept something difficult.
quests.nativeTip: This is a fixed idiom meaning to gradually accept a difficult reality.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'to' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'She's finally coming to terms with her diagnosis after months of denial.'

quests.question: Let's not beat ___ the bush — just tell me what happened.
quests.targetSentence: Let's not beat around the bush — just tell me what happened.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Beat around the bush' is a fixed idiom meaning to avoid saying something directly.
quests.nativeTip: This is a fixed idiom meaning to avoid getting straight to the point.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'around' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'Let's not beat around the bush — just tell me what happened.'

quests.question: The old lighthouse keeper's cottage stood right ___ the water's edge, exposed to every storm that rolled in.
quests.targetSentence: The old lighthouse keeper's cottage stood right at the water's edge, exposed to every storm that rolled in.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'At the water's edge' is the standard fixed idiom treating the shoreline as a precise reference point.
quests.nativeTip: This treats the water's edge as one exact reference point.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'at' (Specific Point (e.g. at the door)) ➔ 'The old lighthouse keeper's cottage stood right at the water's edge, exposed to every storm that rolled in.'

quests.question: After years of solitude, she had grown thoroughly accustomed ___ silence, finding comfort in it rather than dread.
quests.targetSentence: After years of solitude, she had grown thoroughly accustomed to silence, finding comfort in it rather than dread.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Accustomed to' is the fixed idiom for describing gradual adaptation to a condition or situation.
quests.nativeTip: This links a gradual adjustment to the condition someone has adapted to.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'to' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'After years of solitude, she had grown thoroughly accustomed to silence, finding comfort in it rather than dread.'

quests.question: The letter, yellowed ___ age and barely legible, had been tucked away in the attic for generations.
quests.targetSentence: The letter, yellowed with age and barely legible, had been tucked away in the attic for generations.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Yellowed with age' is the standard idiomatic pattern for describing gradual physical change caused by time.
quests.nativeTip: This is the standard idiom for describing gradual physical change caused by the passage of time.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'with' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'The letter, yellowed with age and barely legible, had been tucked away in the attic for generations.'

quests.conceptTitle: Preposition Radar: Contrast: differ from vs differ in
quests.question: The philosophy underlying the reform differs fundamentally ___ that of its predecessor, despite superficial similarities.
quests.targetSentence: The philosophy underlying the reform differs fundamentally from that of its predecessor, despite superficial similarities.
quests.grammarRule: Contrast: differ from vs differ in
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Differs from' introduces the thing being compared against; this is distinct from 'differ in', which instead names the specific respect of difference.
quests.nativeTip: This introduces the specific thing being compared against, unlike naming the aspect of difference.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'from' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'The philosophy underlying the reform differs fundamentally from that of its predecessor, despite superficial similarities.'

quests.question: Her unwavering commitment ___ the cause inspired an entire generation of activists.
quests.targetSentence: Her unwavering commitment to the cause inspired an entire generation of activists.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Commitment to' is the fixed idiom for describing dedication toward a cause or goal.
quests.nativeTip: This links dedication to the goal it's directed toward.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'to' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'Her unwavering commitment to the cause inspired an entire generation of activists.'

quests.question: The report's conclusions were met ___ considerable resistance from stakeholders who felt sidelined during the process.
quests.targetSentence: The report's conclusions were met with considerable resistance from stakeholders who felt sidelined during the process.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Met with' returns here, describing the reaction the report's conclusions received.
quests.nativeTip: This is the same fixed idiom for describing a reaction, taught earlier in this course.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'with' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'The report's conclusions were met with considerable resistance from stakeholders who felt sidelined during the process.'

quests.question: Having weighed the evidence carefully, the jury reached its verdict only ___ nearly twelve hours of deliberation.
quests.targetSentence: Having weighed the evidence carefully, the jury reached its verdict only after nearly twelve hours of deliberation.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'After' marks the point reached once a stated duration had elapsed, showing the verdict came at the end of a long deliberation.
quests.nativeTip: This marks a point reached once a long stretch of time had passed.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'after' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'Having weighed the evidence carefully, the jury reached its verdict only after nearly twelve hours of deliberation.'

quests.question: The committee's final report, ___ several minor revisions, was approved without further debate.
quests.targetSentence: The committee's final report, apart from several minor revisions, was approved without further debate.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Apart from' introduces the one exception to an otherwise straightforward approval, unlike 'along with', which would suggest something additional rather than a small caveat.
quests.nativeTip: This introduces the one exception to an otherwise smooth approval.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'apart from' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'The committee's final report, apart from several minor revisions, was approved without further debate.'

quests.question: By the end of the presentation, even the most skeptical board members had been won ___ by the strength of the data.
quests.targetSentence: By the end of the presentation, even the most skeptical board members had been won over by the strength of the data.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Won over' is a fixed phrasal verb meaning persuaded or convinced, closing out this unit on a note of genuine mastery.
quests.nativeTip: This is a fixed phrasal verb meaning to be persuaded or convinced.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'over' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'By the end of the presentation, even the most skeptical board members had been won over by the strength of the data.'
